'''Travis Merkle''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[2000 Nevada State Championship]] on 8 April 2000, according to Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d487">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-nevada-states-directors-viewd487/ nevada-states-directors-view], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 9 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-nevada-states-directors-viewd487/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
